item.title: Rare seals retreat to caves to escape tourists in Greece
item.description: In a dim sea cave in Greece’s northern Sporades, a massive shadow shifts in the darkness. From a boat offshore, binoculars confirm the sight: a Mediterranean monk seal, among the world’s rarest and largest seals, reaching nearly three metres long and weighing more than 300kg.
